fields.Name: Predictive Studio Gates — Registry and Gate
fields.Description: The PR 4 registry and lifecycle-gate gates: G3.1 (a lost artifact refuses loudly; a kept one scores bit-identically across a sidecar restart), G3.2 (a swapped artifact is refused by SHA-256 mismatch), G3.3 (five out-of-gate Status writes are refused), G3.5 (a retrained challenger does not replace the incumbent on the unchanged data) and G3.11 (an agent's write of a guard field or a stored leakage flag is refused). Needs MJAPI (STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT set, PREDICTIVE_STUDIO_SIDECAR_URL at the truth sidecar), the truth sidecar running (pnpm run truth:sidecar, which writes .run/sidecar.url and .run/sidecar.pid) and `pnpm run truth:provision` done; the mj test process needs STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT too. Run with: MJ_INTEGRATION_TEST=1 RUN_MUTATION_TESTS=1 pnpm mj test suite "Predictive Studio Gates — Registry and Gate"
